summary_en: 20,000,000 shares (10.3% of S/O), ¥30.0B limit, open-market acquisition Aug 3, 2026–Mar 31, 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled Mar 31, 2027. Rationale: per-share value accretion and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On July 31, 2026, Alps Alpine's board of directors resolved to acquire and cancel treasury shares under Companies Act Articles 156 and 178. The company will acquire up to 20,000,000 ordinary shares (10.3% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) for a maximum ¥30.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from August 3, 2026, through March 31, 2027. All shares acquired will be cancelled effective March 31, 2027. The stated rationale is per-share value accretion and improved capital efficiency as part of shareholder return strategy. As of June 30, 2026, the company held 12,989,433 treasury shares against 195,114,317 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
